Tessa Moore: dropping a very short prelaunch handshake + feedback loop we can send to customers showing early renewal friction. one-paragraph customer note + tiny ops hints below.
Ravi Menon: perfect. paste it so SAs can copy.
Tessa Moore: here you go (keeps it customer-facing and actionable):```Prelaunch checklist for quick perf/quality stabilization
1) Metrics snapshot (share): 72h p95 latency, 24h token delta, error %. Flag if p95 > 750ms or errors > 1%.
2) Minimal prefill (customer action): run top-3 prompts with prefill_tokens=900, spacing=10s, 3 repeats each to seed KV cache.
3) Server hints: batch_window=30-70ms, concurrency cap 1-2 per user during ramp, request_timeout=6s. Prefer full-precision model for first 48h.
4) Short pulse: one-question feedback after 24h: "How useful was the assistant today? (0-10)". If <=5, open a 30m triage.
5) Observability to include: redwood.latency.p95, redwood.errors.rate, redwood.cache.hit_ratio, redwood.stream.gap_p90.```
Ivy Chen: add a tiny prefill curl we can paste for eng teams?
Ravi Menon: quick curl (small tokens):```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill-mini 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"account_id":"acct_999","model":"assist-prod","samples":[{"prompt":"<top_prompt>","tokens":900}],"spacing_seconds":10}'
```Note: run with <=2 concurrent clients to avoid quota spikes.
Sam Ortega: can we add a tiny healthcheck customers can run to confirm cache seeding? keeps handoffs clean.
Ivy Chen: simple python healthcheck:```python
# run after prefill completes
def cache_seeded(metrics_client):
    m = metrics_client.query("redwood.cache.hit_ratio", window="1h")
    return getattr(m, 'p90', 0) >= 0.6
```If false, recommend one more round of prefill with the same prompts.
Luis Ortega: small renewal triage heuristic for CSMs: High = usage drop >40% OR pulse <=4 OR unresolved regression in 7d -> 30m eng+CS triage within 72h. Medium = 15-40% drop or p95 600-750ms -> targeted prefill + 7d monitor. Low = stable usage and pulse >=7 -> normal cadence.
Tessa Moore: great. I'll assemble a one-pager and a tiny email snippet for SAs to paste. final note for SAs: if quality drops, gently revert to the previous model variant ("revert to full-precision variant") while investigating.
CS Bot: reminder — add runbook: /repos/cs/runbooks/prelaunch-handshake-checkin.md; label: "prelaunch-check".
Tessa Moore: thanks all, will post TL;DR in #account-health and tag the triage rota if needed. :rocket:
